Known gap: the nishita sampler uses the night midpoint (00:20), where the raw tithi is 24.005 (Navami); Ashtami ends at 00:15. Nishita Kaal is the one-muhurta window 23:57-00:43, where Ashtami still prevails. Phase 2 replaces the point sample with a windowed checkpoint; expected result then becomes ["janmashtami"]. See docs/jyotish_package_improvements_plan.md, Phase 2.
